title: Patch: the daily board shows no 60-second countdown on KY's Competition's questions
thread:
**Issue #3839 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3839: Patch: the daily board shows no 60-second countdown on KY's Competition's questions
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

A follow-up to daily games (#3727, merged in #3762), found in its review and left out of it. Part of the tracker #3726.

### What happens

R3727003 says a daily game's question sequence for KY's Competition (Meditative+ #20) has no 60-second window: the move's own deadline is its window, and the server keeps no clock of seconds. The daily board still shows the live game's countdown on those questions, "Time left: 60 s" ticking down. Nothing enforces it, so reaching 0 does nothing; it only tells the player something false.

- [`apps/web/src/game/Prompt.tsx:819`](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/1964004112/apps/web/src/game/Prompt.tsx#L819-L828): `SequenceCountdown` always calls `useSequenceSecondsLeft` (`apps/web/src/game/sequenceClock.ts`), and the picker renders it on every sequence question ([line 1383](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/1964004112/apps/web/src/game/Prompt.tsx#L1383)).
- [`apps/web/src/daily/DailyBoard.tsx`](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/1964004112/apps/web/src/daily/DailyBoard.tsx) renders the ordinary `Game.tsx`, which renders `Prompt`, with nothing telling it the game is a daily one.

### What should happen

On the daily board a KY's Competition question shows no 60-second countdown (R3727003). It may show the move's daily clock instead (`DailyClockPill.tsx`). A live match and practice keep the 60 seconds (R1563006).

### How to reproduce

Start a daily game (two friends; Challenge, then Daily), play Meditative+ #20 KY's Competition, and look at its first question: `prompt-sequence-clock` is shown and counts down from 60.

### Fix

Let `DailyBoard` tell `Game`, and through it `Prompt`, not to show the sequence countdown (a prop), or to show the daily clock in its place. Add a case to `apps/web/src/daily/DailyBoard.test.tsx`: a KY's Competition question on the daily board shows no `prompt-sequence-clock`. The case must fail without the fix. Keep the live game's own test of the countdown passing.
```
